sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美西语近岸软件研发外包与数字客服中心

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Online Retail of Oversized Furniture and Home Decor

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Colombia (unitary national jurisdiction; S.A.S. registered before the Cámara de Comercio of the chosen domicilio social, e.g., Bogotá D.C.)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: United States–Colombia Trade Promotion Agreement (TPA, in force 2012)
Pacific Alliance Framework Agreement (Colombia, Chile, Mexico, Peru; in force 2014)
Colombia–Spain Agreement on Reciprocal Promotion and Protection of Investments (2007)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 526 de 1999 (creation of the UIAF – Unidad de Información y Análisis Financiero), as amended by Ley 1121 de 2006 and Ley 1762 de 2015; Código Penal (Ley 599 de 2000), Art. 323 (money laundering) and Art. 345-A? (financing of terrorism) as amended; Ley 2155 de 2021 (Social Investment Act, legal basis for the Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales – RUB); Decreto 1670 de 2021 (RUB regulation; 5% ownership/profit or control threshold for final-beneficiary identification); Resolución DIAN 424 de 2022 (RUB filing mechanics); Circular Externa 004 de 2021 de la Superintendencia de Sociedades (SAGRILAFT and AML/CFT internal controls for regulated and supervised commercial companies); Decreto 1074 de 2015 (business registration and commercial registry rules); Código de Comercio, Arts. 110–117 and 527 (formation, name, and registered office requirements).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of existence and legal representation (or equivalent good-standing certificate) of each foreign founding corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry / competent registral authority of the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Colombia is a party to the Hague Apostille Convention; consular legalization is not required, except for non-Hague origin states)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Special or general power of attorney granted by each founding shareholder to the Colombian incorporator / registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille, or consular legalization before the Colombian consulate for non-Hague origin states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized signatures page of the S.A.S. incorporation private document (documento privado de constitución con autenticación notarial de firmas)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Colombian Notaría Pública (or notary in the signing location)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic notarization (autenticación); no apostille required for the domestic registration instrument

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Sworn declaration of final beneficiaries (declaración juramentada de beneficiario final) executed by each shareholder and each final beneficiary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Founding shareholders and Colombian notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic oath (juramento) recorded and incorporated into the RUB filing with DIAN; if executed abroad, apostille required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Spanish translation (traducción oficial) of all non-Spanish corporate and personal documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Certified official translator (traductor oficial) recognized by the Colombian Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Official translation certificate attached to the apostilled originals; translator's signature certified

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all founding shareholders, legal representatives, proxies, and ultimate beneficial owners against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Sanctions List, United Kingdom sanctions list, and Colombian national registries (UIAF money-laundering information, Fiscalía General de la Nación designations, and Procuraduría disciplinary registers for PEPs); enhanced due diligence, including documented source-of-funds and source-of-wealth verification, applies to any Politically Exposed Person (PEP) or shareholder from high-risk jurisdictions; screening is continuous and results are documented in the AML/CFT file and retained for ten years in accordance with Ley 526 de 1999 reporting and record-keeping standards; for a standard-risk online retail S.A.S. using Stripe and Affirm BNPL rails, the compliance officer must mirror processor-level KYC/AML controls and file unusual-operation reports (ROS) with UIAF when indicators arise.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun: All foreign-origin documents must be apostilled or consularized, translated by an official translator, and presented within the certificate validity window; Colombian Chambers of Commerce and notaries routinely reject documents older than 90 days.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial (RUE) and the online name-clearance module of the competent Cámara de Comercio (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá – 'Certificado de homonimia / no similitud' service at www.ccb.org.co or the respective municipal chamber portal)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be expressed in Spanish/Latin script; the suffix 'S.A.S.' is mandatory (Art. 3, Ley 1258 de 2008); foreign-language words are permitted only in the Latin alphabet and must be accompanied by a Spanish-language principal denomination; diacritical marks (ñ, accents) must be reproduced accurately; Arabic numerals may be used; the proposed name must not be identical or phonetically/graphically similar to existing registered names or trademarks, and must comply with the Cámara's homology criteria.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Words implying national sovereignty or public institutions: 'Nacional', 'Presidencia', 'Ministerio', 'Gobierno', 'Banco de la República' (require prior written authorization from the relevant authority)
Regulated-sector tokens: 'Seguros', 'Financiera', 'Bancario', 'Salud', 'Minera', 'Aerolínea', 'Fiduciaria' (require prior operating license or superintendency permit)
Identical or deceptively similar trade names already registered in the commercial registry of any Cámara de Comercio
Suffix confusion: unauthorized use of 'S.A.S.', 'S.A.', 'Ltda.', 'LTDA', 'E.S.P.', 'S. en C.' by entities not qualified under the respective corporate form
Words contrary to public order, decency, morality, or good commercial customs (Art. 113, Código de Comercio)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Cámara de Comercio rejects or objects to the proposed name, the incorporator may file a 'recurso de reposición' (reconsideration motion) with the same Chamber within ten working days of notification under Ley 1437 de 2011 (CPACA), attaching either a fresh homonymy certificate or a legal argument demonstrating distinctiveness and non-confusion; if the reposición is denied, the incorporator may file a 'recurso de apelación' to the Superintendencia de Sociedades within ten working days, whose decision exhausts administrative remedies; in parallel, a substitute name may be reserved without forfeiting the appeal, provided the reservation fee is paid separately; judicial review before the Consejo de Estado is available only after the administrative appeals are exhausted.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Partially permissible: serviced/virtual offices are accepted by the Cámara de Comercio for registering the domicilio social and by DIAN for RUT purposes, provided the service provider maintains a physical establishment in Colombia and reliably receives and channels official correspondence; however, for oversized-furniture e-commerce, the S.A.S. must additionally maintain a real operational presence, such as a warehouse, logistics depot, or showroom, where books, inventory control, customs documentation, and electronic-invoicing (facturación electrónica) records are accessible; a purely virtual address without material substance exposes the entity to SAGRILAFT deficiency findings under Circular Externa 004 de 2021 and to DIAN re-domiciliation or inspection risk.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate: estimated 10% probability per fiscal year of an unannounced DIAN (tax/customs) or municipal inspection for a standard-risk online retail importer; the probability rises to approximately 25% per year if the company undertakes substantial customs import volumes, hires employees, or reports VAT refunds; Cámara de Comercio inspections are predominantly documentary and normally triggered only by third-party complaints or registry inconsistencies.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of S.A.S. incorporation private document, corporate bylaws, and internal AML/UBO documentation in Spanish
Name clearance and homonymy certificate (certificado de homonimia / no similitud)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the chosen domicile
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff per Ley 1429 de 2010 and Chamber fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization (autenticación) of signatures on the incorporation document and UBO sworn declaration
Commercial registration – matrícula mercantil and RUES registration of the S.A.S.
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration tariff computed on declared capital with UVT-based minimum

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RUT (Registro Único Tributario) pre-registration and NIT application
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Initial UBO (RUB – Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales) filing preparation and submission
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: DIAN (direct filing) plus compliance consultant preparation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for consolidated UBO profile; no DIAN filing fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and consular authentication pass on foreign corporate documents (shareholder certificates and powers of attorney)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the origin state / Colombian consulate (where applicable)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official apostille fee of issuing state plus consular statutory fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Spanish translation (traducción oficial) of apostilled corporate and personal documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Official translator (traductor oficial) recognized by the Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark: per-page tariff (approximately USD 15–25 per page)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, OFAC, UN, EU, and Colombian national sanctions screening of all shareholders and ultimate beneficial owners
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External AML compliance officer / screening database provider

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office / serviced office for the S.A.S. (first quarter fee) and courier of apostilled originals

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law 1258 of 2008 (Ley 1258 de 2008), Articles 1–48 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada); Código de Comercio, Articles 110, 372, and 373 for corporate registers and officer appointments; Decreto Único Reglamentario 1074 of 2015, Book 2, Title I, Chapter 1 for commercial registry procedures.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce of the company's registered domicile; e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) and the Superintendencia de Sociedades for post-incorporation filing and legalization of books where applicable.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation instrument) if subscribed capital is paid in full and no real estate contributions; otherwise Public Deed (Escritura Pública) executed before a Notary. Filed via the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) or the Chamber of Commerce single-window portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for S.A.S. under Law 1258 of 2008. Subscribed capital may be zero or divided into authorized, subscribed, and paid-in portions, with payment terms up to two years for cash contributions. Funds may be kept in the company's bank account or corporate treasury; no escrow account is legally mandated for general online retail formation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION NO. 001 OF THE FOUNDING SHAREHOLDER OF [●] S.A.S. — The sole shareholder, having subscribed for one hundred percent (100%) of the issued shares, hereby resolves: (1) to approve the incorporation of [●] S.A.S. under Law 1258 of 2008 and to ratify the bylaws; (2) to adopt as the company's registered office the address [●], Municipality of [●], Colombia, with the legal representative authorized to execute leases and registrations; (3) to appoint [●] as legal representative and [●] as principal and substitute officers, granting the legal representative broad powers for banking, contracts, and regulatory filings. Further, the board authorizes payment of all incorporation fees and filing of the registry form with the competent Chamber of Commerce. Approved unanimously.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio online portal (RUES) or in-person service window of the selected Chamber of Commerce.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the RUES website and submit a name search (consulta de homonimia) for the proposed S.A.S. corporate name. If the name is available, obtain a Certificate of Name Availability (Certificado de Homologación de Nombre) and reserve the name for up to 30 calendar days. The application must state the exact corporate name, the activity 'online retail of oversized furniture and home decor', and the full name and identification of the incorporator.
required_dossiers: DNI/cédula or passport of the founding shareholder if non-resident
Completed name search form stating corporate purpose and registered domicile
Proof of legal representative's acceptance if appointed in the incorporation document
Power of attorney if using a local agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected for similarity to an existing trademark or company, file a formal reconsideration request with the Chamber of Commerce registrar, submit a secondary name choice, or apply to the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio for trademark coexistence authorization if applicable; resubmission is free within the same workflow window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and Execute the S.A.S. Incorporation Instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (if public deed required) or Chamber of Commerce for private document protocol; the founding shareholder signs before the relevant authority.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the private incorporation document (constitución por documento privado) in Spanish, containing the standard S.A.S. clauses: shareholder identification, corporate name, domicile, precise corporate purpose (online retail of oversized furniture and home decor), capital structure, board and officer provisions, annual period, dispute resolution, and liquidation rules. Execute the document before the participating parties, obtaining notarized signatures of the legal representative and the shareholder(s); if the contribution includes real property or if contributions are deferred over two years, use a public deed.
required_dossiers: Name availability certificate
Draft bylaws and incorporation document
Valid identification of all founding shareholders and officers
Document proving capacity/legal status of corporate shareholder if any
RUT (Registro Único Tributario) application form pre-filled for the company
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber of Commerce flags drafting defects, correct the document within the legal cure period and re-file electronically through the RUES; significant defects may require a fresh execution and re-notarization, with confirmation from the Notary or Chamber reviewer.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File the Incorporation Document and Register the Company with the Chamber of Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (commercial registry office) through the RUES single-window system; Superintendencia de Sociedades for public records.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed incorporation instrument and all supporting documents to the Chamber of Commerce via the RUES online portal or in-person service window. The Chamber verifies legal compliance, calculates the registration fee based on the company's capital and assets, and issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal. After registration, file the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) with DIAN to obtain the company's NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria).
required_dossiers: Original or electronically notarized incorporation document
Certificado de Homologación de Nombre
Identification and signature pages of shareholders and legal representative
Completed formulario de registro (registration form) provided by the Chamber
Office address verification data for the registered domicile
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a rejection or requires amendment, correct the observations and resubmit within the Chamber's indicated term. If the RUT filing is delayed, file the tax registration separately via DIAN's online portal before commencing any taxable operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register the Company Books, Seal and Obtain Operational Tax Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Chamber of Commerce for legal book registration; DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) for RUT activation and stamping.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the commercial registration, purchase or print the statutorily required corporate books (libro de actas, libro de registro de accionistas, and accounting books) and have them registered and stamped at the Chamber of Commerce. Confirm the RUT has been updated with the S.A.S. fiscal address and economic activity codes (CIIU 4791 and secondary activities) and request the electronic signature certificate (certificado de firma electrónica) for future tax filings.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
RUT and NIT assigned by DIAN
Corporate books to be legalized
Board resolution authorizing book registration and officer signatories
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If book registration is refused for formal defects, request the Chamber's correction form, adjust pagination or binding, pay the applicable re-registration fee if a new book is required, and resubmit; for DIAN issues, use the DIAN virtual assistant or tax services office to reset the RUT status.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File Post-Incorporation Notices and Open Corporate Bank Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Banco de la República and commercial banks regulated by the Financial Superintendency of Colombia (for account opening); Superintendencia de Sociedades (for annual filings).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate bank account in the S.A.S.'s name, completing KYC/AML verification for all beneficial owners and legal representatives. Present the certificates of existence, RUT, NIT, and the board resolution designating account signatories. The account should be used to receive equity contributions and capitalize the company for e-commerce and freight activities. File any required beneficial ownership information with the Superintendencia de Sociedades within the first quarter and schedule the annual financial statements and board meeting procedures.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal (issued within 90 days)
RUT and NIT
Identification of final beneficial owners
Bank's KYC forms and company constitutional documents
Board resolution naming account signatories
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries the corporate structure due to beneficial owner disclosure, provide a supplemental sworn statement and statutory declaration; if the bank refuses opening, apply to another supervised bank or request a consultation letter from the Financial Superintendency confirming the sufficiency of the S.A.S. documentation.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Comercio, Industria y Turismo and the Cámara de Comercio; for physical operations the municipal planning authority and the Fire Department (Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos) separately issue operational permits.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required at the national level for e-commerce retail; the company must obtain the Municipal Commercial Operating License (Registro de Matrícula Mercantil and, if applicable, the zoning/land-use permit for warehousing or logistics space) and a general security license for physical storage facilities, as applicable.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible through the Regional Autonomous Corporation (CAR) for environmental permitting of storage and logistics facilities
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt for pure online retail with no manufacturing process; a registration with the CAR may be required for warehousing of furniture if total covered area exceeds local thresholds or if the site handles significant waste, hydraulic, or stormwater discharge.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharges must meet Decreto 1076 de 2015 consolidated environmental rules (maximum residual chlorine, pH 5–9, and local BOD/COD limits per municipal sewer authority). VOC emissions from furniture storage are normally negligible; if coating/repair operations are added, Colombian Resolution 2254 de 2017 air quality standards apply. Packaging waste must be managed under Gestión Integral de Residuos Sólidos procedures; all e-commerce packaging waste must comply with Decreto 2184 de 2019 (single-use plastic phase-out).

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Must obtain Fire Safety Certification (Certificado de Condiciones de Seguridad e Higiene) from the Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos for any warehouse or last-mile logistics site, pass structural load inspections for storage racks by the municipal planning authority or a certified structural engineer, and secure occupational health and safety clearance under Decreto 1072 de 2015, Chapter 6 (SGSST). Workspace electrical safety, emergency exits, and fire suppression systems must be inspected; employee emergency plans must be registered with the Risk Administration Company (ARL).

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: DIAN - Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (National Tax and Customs Directorate); sole competent authority for national taxes and customs. Electronic filing and clearance are performed exclusively through the MUISCA portal (Modelo Único de Ingresos, Servicio y Control Automatizado) at https://www.dian.gov.co.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The S.A.S. obtains its NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) automatically at notarial or chamber-of-commerce incorporation. It must then complete the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) enrolment with DIAN, executed by a Colombian-resident legal representative via a DIAN office or through MUISCA with a digital certificate. Procedural sequence: (1) incorporate the S.A.S. and obtain the NIT; (2) enrol in the RUT indicating income-tax status, VAT responsible status (Responsable de IVA) and electronic invoicing operator status; (3) register in the DIAN customs users' registry (Registro de Usuarios Aduaneros) as exporter; (4) enable DIAN free software or a certified billing provider for real-time e-invoicing; (5) certify the legal representative's digital signature. No minimum capital is required and non-resident ownership is expressly allowed; foreign shareholders only need to supply corporate existence documents, not a local TIN.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation; the Colombian S.A.S. is a separate resident taxpayer subject to corporate income tax on worldwide income under Articles 12-22 of the Estatuto Tributario (E.T.). There is no pass-through eligibility, no check-the-box regime, and hybrid-mismatch rules have not been enacted. Territorial scope is worldwide, with the CFC regime applying to certain passive income; Tax_Exempt_Zone (Zona Franca) status exists only upon express application and is not a default attribute of an ordinary commercial S.A.S.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch entity election exists in Colombia. Statutory elections affecting the S.A.S. include: (1) group income-tax consolidation for parent-subsidiary structures (80% or more ownership) under Law 2010 of 2019; (2) participation exemption election (Art. 30-1 E.T.) for foreign-source dividends, subject to CFC rules under Law 1819 of 2016; (3) the Simplified Taxation Regime (Régimen Simple) for small traders whose gross income stays within 3,500 UVT, generally unavailable above that ceiling; and (4) customs duty-deferral plans (Plan Vallejo) for imported inputs embedded in future exports, which do not modify VAT classification. Elections must be filed with DIAN within the corresponding tax-return term; no retroactive election is permitted.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA - Impuesto sobre las Ventas (national Value Added Tax), administered by DIAN on a destination principle; exports of goods are excluded (0%) and qualifying international services are exempt (0%), with the right to claim a refund of input VAT embedded in export costs.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: 3,500 UVT of gross income from taxable operations in the preceding tax year (COP 174,296,500 at the 2025 UVT of COP 49,799). The threshold is also triggered when the current-year projection exceeds 3,500 UVT; for an oversized-furniture online retailer this is effectively exceeded from the first month of recurring sales (approx. COP 14.5 million monthly).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Full digital invoicing mandate: the S.A.S. must issue Factura Electrónica de Venta (FEV) through DIAN-authorised software and transmit the XML to the MUISCA clearance engine in real time; the invoice is legally delivered only after prior electronic validation (validación previa). Each validated invoice is stamped with a CUSE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica) and a QR code. Since 2024-2025, DIAN requires API/web-service integration rather than batch processing; non-compliance triggers a penalty of 1% of the invoice value per infraction and may lead to temporary closure of the establishment.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The S.A.S. may apply 0% VAT to sales of furniture and home decor only when the goods physically leave Colombian customs territory under the definitive export regime (Art. 481 E.T.; Decree 1165 of 2019). Conditions: (1) the S.A.S. must be the exporter of record on the DEX; (2) the goods must be shipped from national customs territory within the deadline contained in the DEX; (3) the buyer must be a non-resident and the invoicing must evidence an export transaction; (4) the foreign-currency proceeds must be channelled through the Colombian foreign-exchange market within 180 calendar days. Qualifying international services (such as hosting, software support and call-centre services provided to foreign clients) can also be exempt at 0% under Decree 1418 of 2020 when the service is regarded as used abroad; however, the physical furniture sale is a goods-export matter and the two regimes are not interchangeable. Input VAT (19%) borne on the export supply chain is recoverable as a refundable VAT balance (saldo a favor) in the bimonthly IVA return.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Declaración de Exportación (DEX) definitiva validated by DIAN through MUISCA, including tariff code, FOB value, net weight and export regime
Bill of Lading (B/L) or Air Waybill (AWB) / Carta Porte Internacional evidencing physical departure from Colombian customs territory
Levante / Visto Bueno - the electronic customs clearance confirmation issued by DIAN authorising the exit of the goods
Commercial invoice and packing list exactly matching the DEX data and the FEV issued by the S.A.S.
Certificado de Reintegro de Divisas (foreign-exchange settlement certificate) or SWIFT MT103 evidencing receipt of export proceeds within the 180-day term
Carrier pick-up proof (e.g., DHL/FedEx shipping receipt) confirming the goods entered the international leg within 48 hours after the DEX
Sales/export contract and, where applicable, certificate of origin supporting the trade
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN undertakes automatic documentary cross-matching between the DEX, FEV, customs controls and the foreign-exchange settlement before any IVA refund (devolución de saldo a favor) is paid. If the export is not physically accomplished within the DEX deadline, or the DEX is declared late or is false, the 0% rate is retroactively stripped: the S.A.S. must restate its IVA returns and pay 19% VAT on the gross sale plus the statutory moratorium interest fixed annually by DIAN, and is liable to penalty under Article 647 E.T. of up to 200% of the tax evaded. False export documents constitute criminal customs fraud (Ley 1762 of 2015) punishable by imprisonment of 60 to 120 months; directors and the legal representative are jointly and severally liable under Article 794 E.T. Failure to repatriate proceeds within the 180-day deadline (or the extended term granted by Banco de la República) triggers exchange-control fines per Banco de la República regulations with statutory minimum penalties per infraction, and DIAN may recharacterise the unrepatriated amount as a deemed distribution taxable as dividend income.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (the Central Bank of Colombia), exercising the compulsory Colombian foreign-exchange regime under Law 9 of 1991 as codified in Decree 1068 of 2015 and the operative compendium Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83, with supervision of banks and AML/CFT conduct by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) and tax/customs enforcement by the Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia maintains a market-determined floating exchange rate with free convertibility on current-account operations (exports and imports of goods and services) subject to mandatory channelling and statistical declaration through an authorized foreign-exchange intermediary (Intermediario del Mercado Cambiario, 'IMC'). Capital-account flows, including inbound foreign direct investment (FDI) into the S.A.S., are freely permitted without prior central-bank authorization, but the investment must be declared on Formulario No. 6 (Declaración de Cambio – Inversiones Internacionales) at the moment of channelling and subsequently reported annually by the non-resident shareholder through the 'Reporte Anual de Inversiones Internacionales'. Profit and dividend remittances to non-resident shareholders are permitted without exchange-control approval provided the FDI is registered, the company's annual financial statements are filed, dividend withholding is settled via the DIAN, and the remittance is executed through an IMC on Formulario No. 1 (Declaración de Cambio – Servicios, Transferencias y Otros Conceptos). The principal practical hurdle is not convertibility limitation but documentary discipline: full traceability of the equity injection, corporate authorization minutes, the RUT/NIT tax registry, and retention of all exchange declarations for a minimum of five years.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83 Chapter 7, 100% of the FOB invoice value of goods exported by the Colombian S.A.S. (oversized furniture and home décor sold online) must be collected from the foreign buyer and channelled into Colombia through an IMC within the contractual payment term, which may not exceed six (6) months from the date of shipment (embarque). Each collection must be declared by the exporter on Formulario No. 3 (Declaración de Cambio – Exportaciones de Bienes), and the currency may be sold to the IMC at the market TRM or deposited in a foreign-currency account maintained at the IMC pending authorized use. A justified extension of up to three (3) additional months may be requested from Banco de la República; failure to channel or declare within the statutory deadline subjects the company to enforced negotiation proceedings and monetary penalties under the exchange regime.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low for use as the primary treasury or operating account of the Colombian resident S.A.S.; Medium as an ancillary collection-and-disbursement rail that feeds the local IMC. Legal constraints: (i) Colombian residents must channel export proceeds, import payments, and FDI exclusively through authorized IMCs, so funds held by a foreign-incorporated EMI (e.g., Wise, Payoneer, Airwallex) cannot by themselves satisfy the exchange-regime obligations; (ii) a foreign EMI without a Colombian SEDPE (Sociedad Especializada en Depósitos y Pagos Electrónicos) license cannot offer COP-denominated local accounts or issue IMC-compliant exchange declarations; and (iii) DIAN e-invoicing and VAT/income-cost traceability require the reconciliation of Stripe/Affirm settlement flows with the local bank statement. The recommended architecture is therefore a binary rail: Stripe/Affirm payouts in USD to the EMIs' wallet as a short-term float, with an automated sweep to the local US-dollar account at the IMC within the DCIN-83 collection deadline.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The S.A.S.'s legal representative (representante legal), who must be an individual resident in Colombia, is required to appear physically at the bank branch (or before a notary for the general powers) to execute the account-opening contracts and UBO certification; a fully remote opening is not available for a newly formed entity with non-resident shareholders under SFC Circular Básica Jurídica Part I, Title IV, Chapter IV. Non-resident shareholders must evidence identity and authority through an apostilled extract of the foreign corporate register, a notarized board resolution appointing the local representative, and a valid passport; the bank will additionally mandate an in-person or video-recorded interview of the signatories and the ultimate beneficial owner as part of heightened due diligence on the inbound FDI structure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident UBO structure – the ultimate shareholder is a foreign individual or entity with no physical presence in Colombia, elevating the risk profile under the Beneficiario Final (UBO) rules of Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled and notarized corporate documents of the parent entity, notarized UBO declaration (Formulario de Beneficiario Final), audited financial statements or tax returns of the shareholder, sworn source-of-funds letter, the FDI exchange declaration (Formulario No. 6), and the commercial lease/warehouse agreements of the Colombian operations site.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: E-commerce-only business model with high-volume, low-ticket card receivables settled through payment aggregators (Stripe, Affirm BNPL), presenting platform-laundering and money-muling typologies typical of ISIC 4791 digital retail.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed payment-processing agreements with Stripe and Affirm, a transaction-to-shipment reconciliation ledger, last-mile delivery proofs of delivery (PODs) for oversized freight, the DIAN RUT and e-invoice certificates, monthly VAT/ICA filings, and the company's written AML/transaction-monitoring program with established thresholds for refunds and chargebacks.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border procurement of oversized furniture from overseas manufacturers with invoice amounts not fully aligned to physical customs movement, triggering trade-based money-laundering red flags on the import side.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Original commercial invoices and packing lists, bills of lading (B/L) or airway bills, marine cargo insurance certificates, customs import declarations (Declaración de Importación) linked to each payment, SWIFT MT103 records, and annual audited financial statements demonstrating an unbroken nexus between procurement and resale revenue.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The non-resident shareholder wires the equity contribution in USD, EUR, or COP via SWIFT MT103 to the S.A.S.'s escrow account at the IMC, referencing 'Aporte de Capital – Inversión Directa – NIT [Registro Tributario]'. The IMC simultaneously prepares and files Formulario No. 6 (Declaración de Cambio – Inversiones Internacionales), which operates as the automatic FDI registration with Banco de la República and secures the investor's future right to access the exchange market for dividends and capital repatriation. Before the wire, the company must have (i) issued and subscribed the S.A.S. shares in the shareholder register (Libro de Registro de Accionistas), (ii) formalized the contribution in a private instrument/receipt, and (iii) updated the Chamber of Commerce certificate (Certificado de Cámara de Comercio) to reflect the paid-in capital; the bank will requirement the W-8-style tax forms for the foreign shareholder and the intended-use-of-funds statement before releasing the escrowed funds for furniture procurement.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails for the S.A.S.'s import settlements: (i) SWIFT MT103 (customer credit transfer) for open-account supplier payments below USD 250,000, declared to the IMC via Formulario No. 2 (Declaración de Cambio – Importaciones de Bienes) at the time of the transfer; (ii) Commercial letter of credit issued by the IMC via SWIFT MT700 for first-time or high-value vendors (USD 250,000 and above), with negotiation against the full shipping set (commercial invoice, packing list, B/L, insurance); and (iii) SWIFT MT103 for ancillary freight, insurance, and customs-brokerage disbursements using the services-declaration concept. All outbound payments must reference the import declaration and be executed at the prevailing TRM through the IMC; unlinked or overdue import payments attract exchange-regime penalties.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable and non-deliverable COP/USD forward contracts (contratos a término) executed through an IMC with a documented underlying import or export exposure under Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83.
FX swaps (simultaneous spot/forward purchase and sale of foreign currency against COP) with an IMC for temporary liquidity conversion.
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps (CCS) permitted where the S.A.S. holds external supplier credit or cross-border financing denominated in USD.
Plain-vanilla COP/USD FX options purchased through an IMC to cap the peso cost of future import disbursement.

NDF (non-deliverable forward) structures settled in COP at the TRM reference rate, entered only with a Colombian IMC and matched to the monthly settlement cycle of the US-dollar receivables from the e-commerce rails.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual renewal of the commercial registration (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil) and update of the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the municipal jurisdiction where the S.A.S. maintains its registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually from January 1 through March 31 for registrations in force on December 31 of the preceding year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers interest, a Chamber of Commerce surcharge, and fines up to 17 UVT; non-renewal for five consecutive years permits ex officio administrative cancellation of the commercial registration.

stage_6.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Colombian S.A.S. entities pay national CIT only on taxable profits at the standard 35% rate; no broad tax holiday for online retail. Preferential reliefs include the 165% additional deduction for qualifying creative-industry ventures (Lev 2010) and the 100% CIT deduction for investment in science, technology and innovation (Article 158-1 ET) subject to previous DIAN certification; these are not generally automatic for furniture e-commerce.
